summary: Error rate spiked to 12% for 18 minutes.
rootCause: Downstream PaymentService timeout caused retry storm; connection pool exhausted.
resolution: Increased connection pool size, added circuit breaker with 5s timeout.

summary: Latency p99 exceeded 4s during peak traffic.
rootCause: SQL Server deadlocks on the Transactions table under concurrent writes.
resolution: Added optimistic concurrency and reduced transaction scope.

summary: Stale inventory counts shown to users for ~10 minutes.
rootCause: Kafka consumer group rebalance delayed message processing.
resolution: Tuned consumer session timeout and added lag monitoring alert.

summary: Scheduled batch job ran 20 minutes over expected window.
rootCause: Larger-than-usual data volume from a promotional event.
resolution: No action needed; documented for capacity planning.
